q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said to me, "I will meet you tomorrow."
o: He told me that he would meet me the next day.
He told me that he will meet you tomorrow.
He told me that he would meet me tomorrow.
He told that he would meet you the next day.
e:
Statement-এর Reported Speech-এ said to হয় told, তার পর Object ও that বসে। will হয় would, tomorrow হয় the next day বা the following day, I হয় he, আর you হয় me (শ্রোতা)। তাই He told me that he would meet me the next day।
মনে রাখুন:
today → that day; yesterday → the previous day; now → then; here → there।

q: The old man said, "I had a vast library in my youth." (Make it indirect)
o: The old man said that he had have a vast library in his youth.
The old man said that he had had a vast library in his youth.
The old man said that he had a vast library in his youth.
The old man said that he have had a vast library in his youth.
e: Direct speech-এ যদি subject-এর পরে শুধু had থাকে এবং এটি main verb হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়, তাহলে Reporting verb অতীত হলে indirect speech-এ তা had + past participle হয়, অর্থাৎ had had। তাই The old man said that he had had a vast library সঠিক। নিয়ম: inverted comma তুলে that বসে, সর্বনামের person বদলায় (I হয়ে he, my হয়ে his), আর verb-এর কাল এক ধাপ পিছিয়ে যায়। অন্য অপশনে have had বা had have-এর মতো ভুল গঠন আছে।

q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said to me, "Please help me."
o: He ordered me to help me.
He told me please to help him.
He said me to help him.
He requested me to help him.
e:
Please থাকলে এটি নম্র অনুরোধ, তাই Reporting Verb requested বা begged ব্যবহৃত হয়। ordered বা commanded কড়া আদেশে বসে। me হয় him, কারণ বক্তা নিজের কথা বলছে, আর পরে to + V1 আসে।
মনে রাখুন:
আদেশ → ordered/commanded; উপদেশ → advised; অনুরোধ → requested; নিষেধ → forbade।
